summary: - **[key4hep/EDM4hep#528](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/528)** — Adds a `timeError` member to `TrackerHit3D`, `TrackerHitPlane`, `SenseWireHit` and the `TrackerHit` interface, alongside the existing `eDepError`. This bumps the schema version, and the previous schema is kept as `old_schemas/edm4hep_v6.yaml`. Downstream code can now carry a per-hit time uncertainty, for example for 4D tracking, instead of using per-sensor placeholders.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#122](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/122)** — Removes the legacy `ACTSSeededCKFTrackingAlg` together with `ACTSAlgBase`, `GeometryIdMappingTool` and `GeometryIdSelector`. Any remaining configurations must move to `CKFTrackingAlg`; v00-05 is the last tag that contains the old algorithm.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#113](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/113)** — GNNTrackFinding now takes native Gaudi list properties instead of comma-separated strings. Old string-based configurations are rejected at configuration time and need updating. The PR also removes unused ONNX helpers and duplicated host-copy code.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1678](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1678)** — `Geant4EventAction` now throws when shared actions are used in single-threaded mode, where they previously behaved wrongly without warning (e.g. writing events twice). The DDSim user output plugin example is corrected for multi-threaded running. Steering files using shared user output plugins (IDEA, ALLEGRO) need the matching update.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/72)** — Adds optional 4D (time-aware) tracking to `CKFTrackingAlg`: `UseHitTimeInCKF` adds hit time as a CKF measurement dimension. `HitTimeResolutions` sets per-sensor time resolutions, as a placeholder until per-hit time errors are available from EDM4hep. `SeedFinding_DoubletTimeCutNSigma` enables the ACTS doublet seed time cut.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/72)** — ConformalTracking gains `ECalBarrelFaceSystemID`/`ECalEndcapFaceSystemID` properties, which default to the ILD/CLD values. This lets detectors such as ALLEGRO get track states at the calorimeter face. GaudiDDKalTest now also installs electromagnetic calorimeters identified by their type flags, and the track fit no longer fails when no calorimeter-face state is found.

- **[HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter#286](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/286)** — Rewrites `PairCaloClustersPi0` as a maximum graph matching using Boost.Graph, which runs in N³ time. The previous exhaustive search was exponential and exhausted memory on hadronic events. Results were verified to match the old algorithm on di-electron and hadronic events, apart from output ordering.

- **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper#490](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/490)** — Fixes Marlin random seeds not being refreshed per event. New events are often allocated at the same address as the previous `LCEvent`, so the pointer-based new-event check skipped the refresh and processors reused the same seeds. A regression test is added.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#434](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/434)** — Fixes the OverlayTiming background cursor: `StartBackgroundEventIndex` is now applied once instead of every event, which had caused the same background events to be overlaid repeatedly. `AllowReusingBackgroundFiles` is now enforced. Jobs that relied on silent reuse must set it explicitly.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#64](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/64)** — `GaussSmearVertex` and `FlatSmearVertex` now shift the whole event position. Beam particles from the HepMC3 root vertex therefore start at the smeared interaction point instead of (0,0,0).

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1691](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1691)** — The HepMC3 event reader now applies the length unit to primary vertex x/y/z. Previously, HepMC3 files in centimetres gave wrong vertex positions.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#109](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/109)** — Fixes a `TracksFromGenParticles` bug: with `ExtrapolateToECal=False`, uninitialized ECAL geometry could still be used, randomly producing garbage calorimeter track states. The extrapolation now runs only when requested. Geometry lookup failures return a proper error status, and the cellID is no longer truncated to 32 bits.

omitted.reason: Runs the LCG and pre-commit workflows in the alma9-cvmfs image to try to reduce CI timeouts.
Makes the LCG-based CI workflow triggerable from the GitHub web UI.
Excludes additional repositories from the release commit-after-tag checks.
Adds HEP-FCC repositories to the exclude list of the commit-after-tag check script.
Removes CEPC repositories from the commit-after-tag checks.
Allows sourcing previous nightlies for the LCG-based stacks as well (lower priority).
Dependabot bump of docker-manifest-create-action to 2.29.0.
Regression engine moves a late-confirmed change window back to the night the level actually changed.
Dashboard Overview offers only releases judged by a report, and chart captions name the plotted nightly tags.
Dashboard release slider ranges platform-wide on the Overview and per detector elsewhere.
Replaces dashboard trend-window presets with a release slider that opens on the 10 newest releases.
Dashboard trend window now counts Key4hep releases across the platform and names when a detector first ran.
Refactors PR blame comments into a package and splits the Overview tab into data, status and render modules.
Dashboard performance work that caches each nightly report parsed once per night and reduces memory use.
Splits the dashboard `app.py` into sidebar pickers, a run loader and a section renderer table.
Adds an unmeasured warm-up before each k4run benchmark run and enables hardware counters in the nightly container.
Benchmark auditor now records per-component heap allocations, page faults, context switches and instruction counts.
Adds `k4bench k4run` to benchmark Gaudi jobs and their variants, including a CLD reconstruction nightly benchmark.
Moves nightly benchmark job logic from Bash into Python driven by a JSON job record.
Adds a Gaudi auditor recording per-component wall time, CPU time and memory costs of k4run jobs.
Centralises the benchmark run-store layout and replaces positional rank-group tuples with named fields.
Dependabot bump of peter-evans/create-pull-request to 8.1.1.
Dependabot bump of streamlit to 1.65.0.
Bumps nightly benchmarks to ALLEGRO o1 v04, CLD o2 v09 and IDEA o1 v04, with regression-lineage succession across versions.
Automates detector version bump PRs for benchmarks based on the Key4hep nightly.
Allows dispatching a subset of nightly benchmark jobs.
Defaults absent `sweep`/`verbose` keys to false in the benchmark matrix.
Splits the timed-process runner from ddsim and centralises run artifact names.
Enables TLS for database connections when available, defaulting to "prefer".
Fixes the frontend API URL so it takes effect at runtime via `NUXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL`.
Renames the project to DaMI at the code level and adds a staging deploy environment.
Adds a tag-triggered production deploy job.
Health endpoints now accept HEAD requests for uptime monitors.
Adds `/healthz` and `/readyz` endpoints with Kubernetes probes.
Fixes a backend mypy error and adds GitHub validation of the backend.
Adds CORS headers to 500 errors and hides exception details from clients.
Requires Boost 1.70 and always uses CONFIG mode to silence CMP0167 warnings downstream.
Removes filesystem detection logic and requires GCC 9.1+.
EDM4hep reader now handles the new MDI synchrotron-radiation files of parentless photons, starting them at their vertex (lower priority).
Runs ACTS master CI directly in the job container with an explicit CVMFS mount.
Adds example logging of the TBB thread count in `CKFTrackingAlg` for multithreading debugging.
Drops redundant edge deduplication in GNNTrackFinding, which may change classifier scores in the last bits.
Replaces GNN classified-edge printing with an `EdgePrintingHook` that prints the graph after every pipeline stage.
Removes unused ACTS headers in `CKFTrackingAlg` to reduce compile memory.
GNNTrackFinding requires an edge-feature phi scale of pi when computing edge features, failing otherwise (lower priority).
GNNTrackFinding makes `EdgeBuildingKnn` an int that must be > 0, improves model-loading error messages and does minor cleanup (lower priority).
Updates GNNTrackFinding for upstream ACTS fixes, requiring Acts >= 48.1.0 and rejecting zero input scales (lower priority).
Adds a verbose option to the CLI and API and silences a GLTFExporter material warning.
Adds a local customization point for calorimeter hits without changing PandoraSDK; results are unchanged (lower priority).
Energy-correction plugins' `IsValid` now checks that scale factors are positive and finite.
Supports the FieldMap-based persistency interface from PandoraSDK v03 while keeping compatibility with older versions.
Adds a CI workflow building against PandoraSDK master.
Adds (theta, energy)-binned EM and hadronic energy correction plugins, a no-op by default (lower priority).
Fixes `CollectionMerger` copy mode, rejects empty inputs that caused a segfault, and makes merging exception-safe (lower priority).
OverlayTiming validates property sizes and the UniqueIDGenSvc, and reduces per-event logging to debug (lower priority).
Requires EDM4hep 1.0 and removes the pre-1.0 cluster phi compatibility check.
Factorises the common ALLEGRO o1/o2 digitisation and reconstruction Gaudi configuration into a shared module (lower priority).
Sets the shared flag of the output plugin to false in single-threaded running in the IDEA and ALLEGRO steering files (lower priority).
Refactors `GGTFTrackFinder`, fixes wire-hit collection index bookkeeping and stops storing the noise/unclustered-hits track (lower priority).
Fixes uninitialized-variable compiler warnings in VTXdigitizerDetailed.
Fixes a CMake typo that installed ARCdigi/VTXdigi headers into the wrong path.
Fixes an unused lambda capture warning.
Fixes file names in the FCC-hh example digi+reco test script when Pythia is used.
Renovate bump of marked to 18.1.0.
Replaces priority dots with border accents and polishes the request views.
Shrinks the Request Details grid gap to match the spacing used elsewhere on the page.
Updates the Delphes+EvtGen tutorial sample generation to the latest Key4hep stack and FCC-config main.
